correctness.rationale: The odd reflection sector is spanned by distinct sine-wave modes u_k vanishing at trap, while every even eigenmode of the cycle Hamiltonian has nonzero trap amplitude. Therefore L0 has semisimple zero exactly on E_k=|u_k><u_k|; all complementary blocks either oscillate at nonzero frequency or decay under the positive trap. The compression ΠDΠ is B−I where B_kl=Σ_j |u_k(j)|²|u_l(j)|². Since the odd projector diagonal is 1/2 on all moved vertices and 0 on reflection-fixed vertices, Σ_l B_kl=1/2; symmetry and nonnegativity give ||B||<=1/2 and 1ᵀ(I−B)^−1=2*1ᵀ. The Schur complement around the semisimple zero mode yields κ(-Lκ)^−1→Π(I−B)^−1Π; trace equals 2Tr(Qρ). The Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation identity rules out peripheral eigenoperators at κ>0, proving finite survival integral. A density supported at reflection-fixed vertex has Πρ=0 and bounded resolvent contribution, giving O(1). Independent direct Liouvillian solves for n3–6, all localized sources, γ=0.9, extrapolate κ=.001,.0002; all 18 match coefficient with max error <6e-7. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove all n or all coherent ρ.
